defs.def: in addition to what has just been stated. Furthermore is used especially to add a point to an argument. 此外；而且；再者

ex.s: Furthermore, AI-powered virtual guides are replacing traditional tour guides.
ex.t: 此外，由人工智能驱动的虚拟导览正在取代传统导游。

ex.s: Furthermore, around 50% of the world’s population live in regions where the figure is now below the replacement level (ie 2.1 births per woman) and almost all developed nations are experiencing sub-replacement birth rate.
ex.t: 此外，约50%的世界人口生活在生育率目前低于替代水平（即每名女性2.1个孩子）的地区，几乎所有发达国家都在经历低于替代水平的生育率。

ex.s: Furthermore, books and movies are two different forms of media and therefore have different rules.
ex.t: 而且，书籍和电影是两种不同的媒体形式，因此有不同的规则。

ex.s: Furthermore, classes were frequently disrupted due to fierce air attacks and often had to be held before 10 am and after 4 pm.
ex.t: 而且，由于猛烈的空袭，课堂常常被打断，只能在上午十点之前和下午四点之后上课。

ex.s: Furthermore, the oceans are a valuable source of natural resources, some of which are completely new to us.
ex.t: 而且，海洋是自然资源的宝贵来源，其中一些对我们来说是完全陌生的。

ex.s: Examples: • 14__________________ • 15__________________ As you read, notice the discourse markers used in the text, eg in addition, also, however, furthermore, as well as.
ex.t: 例子：……当你阅读时，注意文本中使用的话语标记，例如此外、另外、然而、而且、以及。

ex.s: Furthermore, nearly all hydroponic farms and vertical farms are either partially or fully automated.
ex.t: 而且，几乎所有水培农场和垂直农场都是部分或完全自动化的。
